Assumption / Requirement: Private key x is known strictly to Decryptor
Enforcement Mechanism: Never transmitted over network; never logged in software
Known Cryptographic Boundary / Limitatio: If x is compromised adversary can decrypt all historical and future ciphertexts

Assumption / Requirement: Nonce r must be sampled from CSPRNG and never reused
Known Cryptographic Boundary / Limitatio: Reusing r between two messages allows an attacker to compute difference (M1 - M2)*G

Assumption / Requirement: Each sensor maintains independent 32-byte secret K_i
Enforcement Mechanism: Individual sensor key dictionary with length checks
Known Cryptographic Boundary / Limitatio: Shared keys would allow one compromised sensor to forge packets for all other nodes

Assumption / Requirement: Aggregator is untrusted for data confidentiality
Known Cryptographic Boundary / Limitatio: Aggregator performs EC additions blindly without learning individual plaintext temperatures

Assumption / Requirement: Hop-2 MAC proves gateway origin but not arithmetic truth
Enforcement Mechanism: HMAC-SHA256 with Decryptor Key over aggregate
Known Cryptographic Boundary / Limitatio: A malicious aggregator can inject fake ciphertexts into the sum; ZK-SNARKs or verifiable computation would be needed for full arithmetic proof

Assumption / Requirement: Packets must be fresh and in monotonic order
Enforcement Mechanism: Per-sensor sequence tracking and epoch validation
Known Cryptographic Boundary / Limitatio: Clock synchronization across epochs is assumed at protocol level (e.g. NTP or LoRaWAN epoch)

Assumption / Requirement: Weeks 1-4 verify points against known test candidates
Known Cryptographic Boundary / Limitatio: Automated recovery of unknown plaintext sums requires BSGS (Week 5) or Pollard's Kangaroo (Week 6)
